items.title: Rocket Lab, Amazon Win Space Force Contracts. SpaceX Closes Cursor Deal.
items.summary: Space Force taps Rocket Lab, Amazon, Lockheed Martin and more for communications contracts. SpaceX closes $60 billion Cursor deal.

items.title: Is RTX Strengthening Its Position in the Global Missile Market?
items.summary: RTX is expanding missile production and investing in advanced defense technologies as U.S. and allied demand for precision weapons grows.

items.title: Is NOC Expanding Its Joint Domain Command and Control Presence?
items.summary: Northrop Grumman is expanding its JADC2 presence with secure communications, networking and battle management technologies supporting multi-domain operations.

items.title: Can HASTE Help Rocket Lab Tap Into the Growing Hypersonic Market?
items.summary: RKLB expands its launch portfolio through HASTE, supporting hypersonic testing and broadening opportunities in defense missions.

items.title: SpaceX, Defense Contractors Progress On Orbital Interceptors, Pass Golden Dome Test
items.summary: SpaceX, RTX and 10 other defense contractors passed the first space-based interceptor test for the Golden Dome program. Citi hikes aerospace targets.

items.title: Do Options Traders Know Something About Lockheed Martin Stock We Don't?
items.summary: Investors need to pay close attention to LMT stock based on the movements in the options market lately.

items.title: Can GE Stock Compound Its Way Higher?
items.summary: Despite record revenue, GE Aerospace is falling further behind on orders. Spare parts delinquencies, a measure of shipments delayed by material shortages, grew last quarter. This is not a sign of weakness, but of demand so intense the company's industrial base cannot keep pace.

items.title: Can Rising Fighter Jet Demand Sustain Boeing's Defense Growth?
items.summary: BA's fighter jet business stands to gain from rising defense spending, fleet modernization and demand for aircraft upgrades and sustainment.
